# GTA Helical Piles

Helical (screw) pile installation contractor serving Halton, Peel, Hamilton and Guelph, Ontario. Decks, additions, underpinning. Every page states its sources.

## Pages

- https://gtahelicalpiles.ca/ : what we do, where we work, how to get a quote
- https://gtahelicalpiles.ca/locations/oakville/ : Oakville: soil, permits, frost depth, pricing, FAQ
- https://gtahelicalpiles.ca/guides/helical-pile-cost-per-pile-ontario/ : cost per pile in Ontario, what moves the price, budget calculator

## Data

Price ranges and local facts on each page carry a source and a last-reviewed date. Prices are confirmed after a site review.
